n a meaning that is not expressly stated but can be inferred
n having important effects or influence
v bring in from abroad
v transfer (electronic data) into a database or document
v indicate or signify
definitionZh: n. 进口商品；进口总额（import的复数）

example.text: The country's imports of oil have risen sharply this year.
example.translationZh: 今年该国石油进口量急剧上升。

definitionEn:
v compel to behave in a certain way
v impose something unpleasant
v impose and collect
s impressive in appearance
s used of a person's appearance or behavior; befitting an eminent person
definitionZh: a. 令人难忘的, 壮丽的, 威风的

example.text: The courthouse is an imposing building with tall stone columns and a grand entrance.
example.translationZh: 这座法院是一座宏伟的建筑，有着高高的石柱和雄伟的入口。

definitionEn:
n. something that cannot be done
a. not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
s. totally unlikely
s. used of persons or their behavior
definitionZh: a. 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的

example.text: Finishing the report in one hour is an impossible task for me.
example.translationZh: 对我来说，一小时内完成这份报告是不可能完成的任务。

definitionEn: a. making a strong or vivid impression\ns. producing a strong effect
definitionZh: a. 给人深刻印象的, 威严的

example.text: Her research on climate change was an impressive achievement for such a young scientist.
example.translationZh: 她关于气候变化的研究对如此年轻的科学家来说是一项令人印象深刻的成就。

definitionEn: n. an extemporaneous speech or remark\nn. a short musical passage that seems to have been made spontaneously without advance preparation
definitionZh: n. 即席演出, 即兴曲\na. 即席的\nadv. 即席

example.text: She gave an impromptu speech at her colleague's farewell party.
example.translationZh: 她在同事的欢送会上做了一次即兴演讲。

definitionEn: n. a change for the better; progress in development\nn. the act of improving something\nn. a condition superior to an earlier condition
definitionZh: n. 进步, 改善, 利用\n[医] 改善, 好转, 进步

example.text: The new manager has brought about a significant improvement in staff morale.
example.translationZh: 新经理使员工士气有了显著提升。

definitionEn: v. perform without preparation\nv. manage in a makeshift way; do with whatever is at hand
definitionZh: vt. 即席创作, 临时做

example.text: When the guest speaker cancelled at the last minute, she had to improvise a short talk for the audience.
example.translationZh: 当演讲嘉宾在最后一刻取消时，她不得不为观众即兴做一段简短的演讲。

definitionEn: n. the act of applying force suddenly
definitionZh: n. 冲动, 驱使, 刺激, 推动, 冲力, 建议, 脉冲\nvt. 推动

example.text: She bought the expensive dress on impulse, without even trying it on.
example.translationZh: 她一时冲动买下了那条昂贵的裙子，甚至都没有试穿。

definitionEn:
s. holding office
s. directed or bound inward
s. currently fashionable
r. to or toward the inside of
definitionZh:
prep. 在...期间, 在...之内, 处于...之中, 从事于, 按照, 穿着
adv. 进入, 朝里, 在里面, 在屋里
a. 在里面的, 在朝的
n. 执政者, 交情

example.text: The ambulance arrived in time to save the child.
example.translationZh: 救护车及时赶到，救了那个孩子。

definitionEn: n. lack of ability (especially mental ability) to do something\nn. lacking the power to perform
definitionZh: n. 无能, 无力

example.text: His inability to concentrate made it hard for him to finish the report on time.
example.translationZh: 他无法集中注意力，这使他很难按时完成报告。

definitionEn: a. not exact
definitionZh: a. 错误的, 不准确的\n[化] 不精确

example.text: The report was criticized for containing highly inaccurate data.
example.translationZh: 这份报告因含有非常不准确的数据而受到批评。

definitionEn: a. lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task\ns. not sufficient to meet a need
definitionZh: a. 不充分的, 不适当的\n[法] 不充分的, 不适当的

example.text: The village clinic had an inadequate supply of medicine during the outbreak.
example.translationZh: 疫情期间，这家乡村诊所的药品供应不足。

definitionEn: s not elegant or graceful in expression
definitionZh: a. 不适当的, 不熟练的

example.text: His speech was full of inapt remarks that made the audience uncomfortable.
example.translationZh: 他的演讲充满了不恰当的言论，让听众感到不舒服。

definitionEn: v. commence officially\nv. open ceremoniously or dedicate formally\nv. be a precursor of
definitionZh: vt. 开始, 举行...就职典礼

example.text: The new president will be inaugurated in January.
example.translationZh: 新总统将于一月宣誓就职。

definitionEn: r. of a minor or subordinate nature
definitionZh: adv. 伴随地, 偶然, 顺便

example.text: Incidentally, the meeting has been moved to Thursday afternoon.
example.translationZh: 顺便说一下，会议已经改到周四下午了。

phrase.text: incidentally, I saw your brother downtown yesterday
phrase.translationZh: 顺便提一下，我昨天在市中心看到了你哥哥

definitionEn: s. only partly in existence; imperfectly formed
definitionZh: a. 起初的, 发端的, 初期的\n[医] 初发的, 初期的

example.text: The doctor noticed the incipient stage of the disease before any symptoms appeared.
example.translationZh: 医生在任何症状出现之前就注意到了这种疾病的初期阶段。

definitionEn: v. provoke or stir up
definitionZh: vt. 刺激, 激励, 引诱\n[法] 鼓动, 煽动

example.text: The police arrested the men who were trying to incite violence outside the stadium.
example.translationZh: 警方逮捕了那些试图在体育场外煽动暴力的男子。

definitionEn:
n. an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
n. (astronomy) the angle between the plane of the orbit and the plane of the ecliptic stated in degrees
n. (geometry) the angle formed by the x-axis and a given line (measured counterclockwise from the positive half of the x-axis)
n. that toward which you are inclined to feel a liking
definitionZh: n. 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头\n[化] 倾角

example.text: She has an inclination to avoid conflict whenever possible.
example.translationZh: 她倾向于尽可能避免冲突。

definitionEn: a. including much or everything; and especially including stated limits
definitionZh: a. 包含的, 包括的

example.text: The resort offers an all-inclusive package that covers meals, drinks, and activities.
example.translationZh: 这家度假村提供全包式套餐，涵盖餐食、饮品和活动。

definitionEn: a. arriving at a place or position\na. entering upon a position of office vacated by another
definitionZh: a. 进来的, 刚开始的, 新来的\nn. 进来

example.text: She ignored the incoming call because she was in a meeting.
example.translationZh: 她因为在开会而没有接听那通来电。

definitionEn: a. lacking in harmony or compatibility or appropriateness
definitionZh: a. 不协调的, 不一致的, 不合适的

example.text: The modern glass tower looked incongruous among the old brick houses.
example.translationZh: 那座现代玻璃高楼在古老砖房之间显得很不协调。

definitionEn: a. beyond belief or understanding
definitionZh: a. 难以置信的

example.text: Winning the championship in their first season was an incredible achievement.
example.translationZh: 在他们第一个赛季就赢得冠军是一项令人难以置信的成就。

phrase.translationZh: 一项令人难以置信的成就

definitionEn: n a process of becoming larger or longer or more numerous or more important\nn the amount by which something increases
definitionZh: n. 增加, 增值, 盈余\n[计] 增量

example.text: Employees receive an annual increment based on their performance review.
example.translationZh: 员工根据绩效评估获得年度加薪。

definitionEn: v. make oneself subject to; bring upon oneself; become liable to
definitionZh: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇\n[经] 招致, 蒙受, 担负

example.text: If you cancel the booking late, you will incur extra charges.
example.translationZh: 如果你取消预订太晚，就会产生额外费用。

definitionEn: a. vague or not clearly defined or stated\ns. not decided or not known
definitionZh: a. 模糊的, 不确定的, 无限的\n[法] 不确定的, 无限制的

example.text: The project has been postponed for an indefinite period.
example.translationZh: 该项目已被无限期推迟。

definitionEn: s. cannot be removed or erased
definitionZh: a. 难以消除的, 不能拭除的, 难忘的

example.text: The experience left an indelible mark on her memory.
example.translationZh: 这段经历在她记忆中留下了不可磨灭的印记。

phrase.translationZh: 不褪色墨水；难以擦除的墨水

definitionEn: n. protection against future loss\nn. legal exemption from liability for damages
definitionZh: n. 赔偿, 保障, 补偿, 赦免, 保护\n[经] 赔偿, 补偿, 赔偿金

example.text: The contract includes an indemnity clause to protect the company from future losses.
example.translationZh: 合同中包含一项赔偿条款，以保护公司免受未来损失。

definitionEn: n. freedom from control or influence of another or others\nn. the successful ending of the American Revolution\nn. a city in western Missouri; the beginning of the Santa Fe Trail
definitionZh: n. 独立, 自立, 自主\n[医] 自主性, 独立性

example.text: The colonies declared independence from Britain in 1776.
example.translationZh: 这些殖民地在1776年宣布脱离英国独立。

definitionEn: n. a member of the race of people living in America when Europeans arrived\nn. a native or inhabitant of India\na. of or relating to or characteristic of India or the East Indies or their peoples or languages or cultures
definitionZh: n. 印度人, 印第安人, 印第安语\na. 印度的, 印度群岛的, 印第安语的

example.text: We enjoyed an Indian summer in October, with warm sunshine and clear skies.
example.translationZh: 我们在十月享受了一段小阳春，阳光温暖，天空晴朗。

phrase.translationZh: 小阳春；深秋的暖和天气

definitionEn: a. relating to the mood of verbs that is used simple in declarative statements\ns. (usually followed by `of') pointing out or revealing clearly
definitionZh: a. 指示的, 象征的, 表示...的\n[经] 指标的

example.text: A sudden drop in temperature is often indicative of an approaching storm.
example.translationZh: 气温骤降往往表明暴风雨即将来临。

definitionEn: n. a signal for attracting attention\nn. a device for showing the operating condition of some system\nn. (chemistry) a substance that changes color to indicate the presence of some ion or substance; can be used to indicate the completion of a chemical reaction or (in medicine) to test for a particular reaction
definitionZh: n. 指示器, 指示剂, 指标\n[计] 指示器

example.text: The unemployment rate is a key economic indicator that analysts watch closely.
example.translationZh: 失业率是分析师密切关注的关键经济指标。

definitionEn:
s. showing no care or concern in attitude or action
s. fairly poor to not very good
s. marked by no especial liking or dislike or preference for one thing over another
s. characterized by a lack of partiality
definitionZh: a. 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的\n[医] 中性的, 无作用的, 无亲和力的, 淡漠的

example.text: She remained indifferent to the criticism and kept working on her project.
example.translationZh: 她对批评漠不关心，继续做她的项目。

definitionEn: s originating where it is found
definitionZh: a. 本土的, 国产的, 固有的\n[医] 原产的, 本土的

example.text: The museum works closely with indigenous people to preserve their traditional languages.
example.translationZh: 这家博物馆与原住民密切合作，以保护他们的传统语言。

definitionEn: s. angered at something unjust or wrong
definitionZh: a. 愤怒的, 愤慨的

example.text: She was indignant at the way her colleagues had been treated.
example.translationZh: 她对同事们所受的待遇感到愤慨。

definitionEn: a. not to be dispensed with; essential\ns. unavoidable
definitionZh: n. 不可缺少之物\na. 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的

example.text: Clean water is indispensable to public health.
example.translationZh: 清洁的水对公共卫生不可或缺。

definitionEn: v. give free rein to\nv. enjoy to excess
definitionZh: vt. 纵情于, 使高兴, 放任, 迁就\nvi. 沉溺

example.text: On weekends she likes to indulge in a long, lazy breakfast with her family.
example.translationZh: 周末她喜欢和家人一起悠闲地享受一顿漫长的早餐。

definitionEn:
a. of or relating to or resulting from industry
a. having highly developed industries
s. employed in industry
s. suitable to stand up to hard wear
definitionZh: a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的\nn. 工业工人, 工业股票

example.text: The country's industrial production increased by five percent last year.
example.translationZh: 该国的工业生产去年增长了百分之五。

definitionEn: n. the people or companies engaged in a particular kind of commercial enterprise\nn. the organized action of making of goods and services for sale
definitionZh: n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动\n[经] 工业, 实业

example.text: The government is investing heavily in heavy industry to boost the national economy.
example.translationZh: 政府正在大力投资重工业以促进国民经济。

definitionEn: s. revealing lack of perceptiveness or judgment or finesse
definitionZh: a. 不适当的, 不理智的, 笨拙的\n[法] 不称职者, 无能的, 不符要求的

example.text: His socially inept remarks made everyone at the party uncomfortable.
example.translationZh: 他在聚会上社交笨拙的言论让每个人都感到不舒服。

definitionEn: s. unable to move or resist motion\ns. having only a limited ability to react chemically; chemically inactive\ns. slow and apathetic
definitionZh: a. 惰性的, 迟钝的, 无活力的, 呆滞的\n[医] 惰性的, 无作用的, 无效的

example.text: Helium is an inert gas that does not react with other elements.
example.translationZh: 氦是一种惰性气体，不会与其他元素发生反应。

definitionEn: n. (physics) the tendency of a body to maintain its state of rest or uniform motion unless acted upon by an external force
definitionZh: n. 惯性, 惰性, 迟钝\n[化] 惯性

example.text: The moment of inertia of a solid sphere is 2/5 mr².
example.translationZh: 实心球的转动惯量是2/5 mr²。

definitionEn: n a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
definitionZh: n. 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者\na. 婴儿的, 幼稚的

example.text: The hospital has a special unit for infant care.
example.translationZh: 这家医院设有专门的婴儿护理部门。

definitionEn:
v. communicate a disease to
v. contaminate with a disease or microorganism
v. corrupt with ideas or an ideology
v. affect in a contagious way
definitionZh: vt. 传染, 感染\n[医] 传染, 感染

example.text: The virus can infect people through close contact.
example.translationZh: 这种病毒可以通过密切接触传染给人们。

definitionEn:
n. the pathological state resulting from the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms
n. (phonetics) the alteration of a speech sound under the influence of a neighboring sound
n. (medicine) the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms and their multiplication which can lead to tissue damage and disease
n. an incident in which an infectious disease is transmitted
definitionZh: n. 传染, 影响, 传染病\n[医] 传染, 感染

example.text: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the bacterial infection.
example.translationZh: 医生开了抗生素来治疗细菌感染。

definitionEn: s. caused by infection or capable of causing infection\na. easily spread; children catch it from their elders"- Bertrand Russell\na. of or relating to infection
definitionZh: a. 有传染性的, 易传染的\n[医] 传染性的

example.text: The doctor warned that the infectious disease could spread quickly through the crowded school.
example.translationZh: 医生警告说，这种传染病可能会在拥挤的学校里迅速传播。

definitionEn: n. the reasoning involved in drawing a conclusion or making a logical judgment on the basis of circumstantial evidence and prior conclusions rather than on the basis of direct observation
definitionZh: n. 推论\n[法] 推论, 推理, 推断

example.text: From the evidence, the detective drew the inference that the suspect had left the country.
example.translationZh: 根据证据，侦探推断嫌疑人已经离开了这个国家。

definitionEn:
n. one of lesser rank or station or quality
a. of or characteristic of low rank or importance
a. of low or inferior quality
a. having an orbit between the sun and the Earth's orbit
definitionZh: a. 次等的, 较差的, 下方的, 下级的\nn. 部下, 次品, 下标(符号)

example.text: The store was criticized for selling inferior quality goods at premium prices.
example.translationZh: 这家商店因以高价出售劣质商品而受到批评。

definitionEn: v. invade in great numbers\nv. live on or in a host, as of parasites
definitionZh: vt. 骚扰, 寄生于, 大批出没\n[医] 传染, 感染

example.text: The old house was infested with rats.
example.translationZh: 那座老房子鼠患成灾。

definitionEn: a. having no limits or boundaries in time or space or extent or magnitude\na. of verbs; having neither person nor number nor mood (as a participle or gerund or infinitive)\ns. total and all-embracing
definitionZh: n. 无限, 神\na. 无穷的, 无限的, 极大的

example.text: The new technology opens up infinite possibilities for communication.
example.translationZh: 这项新技术为通信开辟了无限的可能性。

definitionEn: n a health facility where patients receive treatment
definitionZh: n. 医院, 养老院\n[医] 医务所, 医务室, 小医院

example.text: The nurse at the school infirmary bandaged his sprained ankle.
example.translationZh: 学校医务室的护士给他扭伤的脚踝缠上了绷带。

definitionEn: n. a general and progressive increase in prices\nn. (cosmology) a brief exponential expansion of the universe (faster than the speed of light) postulated to have occurred shortly after the big bang\nn. the act of filling something with air
definitionZh: n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀\n[化] 充气吹胀; 膨胀

example.text: The central bank raised interest rates to bring down the inflation rate.
example.translationZh: 中央银行提高利率以降低通货膨胀率。

definitionEn: v. impose something unpleasant
definitionZh: vt. 施以, 加害, 使承受\n[法] 处, 加, 予以

example.text: The storm inflicted severe damage on the coastal villages.
example.translationZh: 这场风暴给沿海村庄造成了严重的破坏。

definitionEn:
n. a power to affect persons or events especially power based on prestige etc
n. causing something without any direct or apparent effort
n. a cognitive factor that tends to have an effect on what you do
n. the effect of one thing (or person) on another
definitionZh: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力\nvt. 影响, 改变

example.text: Social media can have a strong influence on how young people view themselves.
example.translationZh: 社交媒体会对年轻人如何看待自己产生重大影响。

definitionEn: n the process of flowing in
definitionZh: n. 流入, 河口, 汇集\n[医] 注入, 流入

example.text: The small town struggled to handle the sudden influx of tourists during the summer festival.
example.translationZh: 夏季节日期间游客突然大量涌入，这座小镇难以应对。

definitionEn:
n. a message received and understood
n. knowledge acquired through study or experience or instruction
n. formal accusation of a crime
n. (communication theory) a numerical measure of the uncertainty of an outcome
definitionZh: n. 消息, 知识, 通知, 情报, 信息, 问讯处, 起诉\n[计] 信息

example.text: Please contact the front desk for further information about the tour.
example.translationZh: 如需了解此次游览的更多信息，请联系前台。

definitionEn: a. providing or conveying information
definitionZh: a. 提供消息的, 见闻广博的

example.text: The professor gave an informative lecture on climate change.
example.translationZh: 教授做了一场关于气候变化的、内容丰富的讲座。

definitionEn: v go against, as of rules and laws\nv advance beyond the usual limit
definitionZh: v. 破坏, 侵犯, 违反

example.text: The new regulations may infringe on citizens' right to privacy.
example.translationZh: 新规定可能会侵犯公民的隐私权。

definitionEn: s showing inventiveness and skill
definitionZh: a. 灵敏的, 精巧的, 聪明的

example.text: The engineer came up with an ingenious solution to the water shortage.
example.translationZh: 这位工程师想出了一个解决缺水问题的巧妙方案。

definitionEn: n. a component of a mixture or compound\nn. food that is a component of a mixture in cooking
definitionZh: n. 成分, 因素\n[化] 配合剂; 拼料; 成分; 组分

example.text: Flour is the main ingredient in this bread recipe.
example.translationZh: 面粉是这个面包食谱中的主要原料。

definitionEn: v. be present in
definitionZh: vt. 居住于, 占据, 栖息

example.text: Many rare birds inhabit the forest.
example.translationZh: 许多珍稀鸟类栖息在这片森林里。

definitionEn: n. a person who inhabits a particular place
definitionZh: n. 居民, 居住者\n[医] 居民

example.text: The island's only inhabitants are a few fishermen and their families.
example.translationZh: 这个岛上唯一的居民是几个渔夫和他们的家人。

definitionEn: v. obtain from someone after their death\nv. receive from a predecessor\nv. receive by genetic transmission
definitionZh: vt. 继承, 遗传\nvi. 接受遗产

example.text: She inherited a large fortune from her grandfather.
example.translationZh: 她从祖父那里继承了一大笔财产。

definitionEn: n readiness to embark on bold new ventures\nn the first of a series of actions\ns serving to set in motion
definitionZh: n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权\na. 自发的, 起始的

example.text: She decided to take the initiative and organize a community clean-up event.
example.translationZh: 她决定采取主动，组织一次社区清洁活动。

definitionEn:
v. give an injection to
v. to introduce (a new aspect or element)
v. force or drive (a fluid or gas) into by piercing
v. take by injection
definitionZh: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入轨\n[医] 注射

example.text: The nurse will inject the vaccine into your arm.
example.translationZh: 护士会把疫苗注射到你的手臂里。

definitionEn: n. the forceful insertion of a substance under pressure\nn. any solution that is injected (as into the skin)\nn. the act of putting a liquid into the body by means of a syringe
definitionZh: n. 注射, 注射剂\n[化] 注入; 注射

example.text: The mechanic checked the fuel injection system to find out why the engine was losing power.
example.translationZh: 机械师检查了燃油喷射系统，以查明发动机为什么会失去动力。

definitionEn:
n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.
n. an accident that results in physical damage or hurt
n. an act that causes someone or something to receive physical damage
n. wrongdoing that violates another's rights and is unjustly inflicted
definitionZh: n. 伤害, 侮辱\n[医] 伤, 损伤

example.text: The athlete suffered a knee injury during the match.
example.translationZh: 这位运动员在比赛中膝盖受伤。

definitionEn: a. situated away from an area's coast or border\nr. towards or into the interior of a region
definitionZh: a. 内陆的, 国内的\nn. 内地

example.text: They traveled inland to explore the mountains.
example.translationZh: 他们向内陆旅行去探索群山。

definitionEn:
n. a person who lacks knowledge of evil
a. free from evil or guilt
s. lacking intent or capacity to injure
s. lacking in sophistication or worldliness
definitionZh: a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的\nn. 天真的人, 笨蛋

example.text: The charity works to free innocent prisoners who were wrongly convicted.
example.translationZh: 该慈善机构致力于释放被错误定罪的无辜囚犯。

definitionEn: n a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation\nn the creation of something in the mind\nn the act of starting something for the first time; introducing something new
definitionZh: n. 改革, 创新\n[法] 创新, 改革, 刷新

example.text: The company's success is largely due to its focus on technological innovation.
example.translationZh: 这家公司的成功很大程度上归功于其对技术创新的专注。

definitionEn: s too numerous to be counted
definitionZh: a. 无数的, 数不清的

example.text: On a clear night, innumerable stars light up the sky.
example.translationZh: 在晴朗的夜晚，无数的星星照亮了天空。

definitionEn: v inquire about\nv have a wish or desire to know something\nv conduct an inquiry or investigation of
definitionZh: v. 询问, 问明, 查究

example.text: She called the hotel to inquire about available rooms for the weekend.
example.translationZh: 她打电话给酒店，询问周末是否有空房。

definitionEn: n a search for knowledge\nn an instance of questioning\nn a systematic investigation of a matter of public interest
definitionZh: n. 调查( inquiry的名词复数 ); 疑问; 探究; 打听

example.text: The police are making inquiries about the missing painting.
example.translationZh: 警方正在对这起名画失踪案进行调查。

definitionEn: a. afflicted with or characteristic of mental derangement
definitionZh: a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的\n[医] 神经错乱的

example.text: The constant noise from the construction site is enough to drive anyone insane.
example.translationZh: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音足以把任何人逼疯。

phrase.translationZh: 把某人逼疯；使某人精神崩溃

definitionEn: n. small air-breathing arthropod
definitionZh: n. 昆虫, 卑鄙的人\n[医] 昆虫

example.text: She stayed indoors because an insect bite on her arm had become swollen.
example.translationZh: 她待在室内，因为手臂上被昆虫叮咬的地方肿了起来。

definitionEn: n small air-breathing arthropod\nn a person who has a nasty or unethical character undeserving of respect
definitionZh: n. 昆虫；昆虫类, 昆虫纲（insect的复数形式）

example.text: Insects such as bees and butterflies help pollinate many of the crops we eat.
example.translationZh: 蜜蜂和蝴蝶等昆虫帮助许多我们食用的农作物授粉。

definitionEn: s. lacking interest or significance or impact
definitionZh: a. 乏味的, 清淡的, 难吃的\n[医] 无味的

example.text: The film was criticized for its insipid dialogue and shallow characters.
example.translationZh: 这部电影因对白乏味、人物浅薄而受到批评。

definitionEn: s marked by casual disrespect\ns unrestrained by convention or propriety
definitionZh: n. 侮慢无礼的人\na. 粗野的, 无礼的, 侮慢的

example.text: The clerk gave me an insolent reply when I asked for help.
example.translationZh: 当我请求帮助时，那个职员给了我一个傲慢无礼的回答。

definitionEn: a. unable to meet or discharge financial obligations
definitionZh: a. 无力偿还的, 破产的\nn. 无力偿还者, 破产者

example.text: The company became insolvent after several years of declining sales.
example.translationZh: 由于销售额连年下降，这家公司变得无力偿还债务。

definitionEn: n. an inability to sleep; chronic sleeplessness
definitionZh: n. 失眠症\n[医] 失眠[症]

example.text: She has been suffering from insomnia since the accident.
example.translationZh: 自从那次事故后，她一直患有失眠症。

definitionEn: n. a formal or official examination
definitionZh: n. 检验, 检查, 视察\n[医] 检查, 视察, 监督, 望诊

example.text: The health department will carry out an inspection of the restaurant next week.
example.translationZh: 卫生部门下周将对这家餐厅进行检查。

definitionEn: n. arousal of the mind to special unusual activity or creativity\nn. a product of your creative thinking and work\nn. a sudden intuition as part of solving a problem
definitionZh: n. 灵感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙计, 吸气\n[医] 吸[气]

example.text: The ocean has always been a source of inspiration for her paintings.
example.translationZh: 海洋一直是她绘画的灵感源泉。

definitionEn: v. heighten or intensify\nv. supply the inspiration for
definitionZh: vt. 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感\nvi. 吸入, 赋予灵感

example.text: Her calm voice helped inspire confidence in the nervous new employees.
example.translationZh: 她平静的声音有助于激发紧张的新员工们的信心。

definitionEn: a. stimulating or exalting to the spirit
definitionZh: a. 鼓舞人心的

example.text: Her speech was so inspiring that many students decided to volunteer in their community.
example.translationZh: 她的演讲如此鼓舞人心，以至于许多学生决定在社区做志愿者。

definitionEn: v. set up for use\nv. put into an office or a position\nv. place
definitionZh: vt. 安装, 安置, 使就职\n[计] 安装, 安装程序; DOS内部命令:安装常驻程序

example.text: The technician will install the new software on your laptop this afternoon.
example.translationZh: 技术人员今天下午会在你的笔记本电脑上安装新软件。
